Kairos is the personal analytics engine for everything you'd otherwise spread across seven apps and a spreadsheet. One timeline, your data, your patterns—surfaced, never prescribed. MORNING RATING Each morning the home page asks you to rate yesterday across three axes — energy, mood, focus — on a 1–5 scale. Your ratings become first-class features in the analyzer: modes get characterized in your own vocabulary, and coupling can answer "what tracks with mood?" against every other series you're collecting. HEALTH Connect Apple Health on your iPhone. Sleep, HRV, recovery, workouts, and steps flow into one timeline. Compatible with WHOOP, Oura, Garmin, Fitbit, and Apple Watch — all write into HealthKit; Kairos reads from there. Strava, Peloton, Zwift, and Nike Run Club workouts route the same [...] Peloton, Zwift, and Nike Run Club workouts route the same way — enable each app's Apple Health export. PHONE Connect your encrypted iPhone backup from a Mac. Messages, calls, and photos become heatmaps, time-of-day histograms, and top-contact rankings. Friends can be tagged for faster recall and relationship-depth tracking. SPEND Plaid integration imports transactions and balances across banks, brokerages, and credit cards. Auto-categorized via 15 curated tags. Recurring subscriptions auto-detected from your transactions — track them before they pile up. SCHEDULE Sync up to five Google, Microsoft, or Apple iCloud calendars side-by-side. Meeting load, free-time breakdown, and category mix across 30d / 90d / 1y windows.
